title: The Death of Affordable Computing | Tariffs Impact & Investigation
summary: A long Gamers Nexus investigation into how volatile US tariffs affect the computer hardware industry. It interviews manufacturers and sellers about costs, margins and why moving production to the US is hard.
why: HN recommends it for concrete numbers on what tariffs do to small hardware businesses.

quote.text: Best part is having a product manager show a spreadsheet of costs and margins and explain in real terms ($$$) what tariffs do to their business.
